messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our offer stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms with a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We maintain our standard payment terms of 30 days net to support this revised offer.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We note that your latest proposal is identical to your initial request. As we have already incorporated the verified volume increase into our revised pricing, we cannot offer further reductions without reciprocal movement. We therefore maintain our current offer and ask you to reconsider your position.

Accordingly, our offer stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
